description: Source code for the MultiLogCTVerifier class, which verifies Certificate Transparency SCTs using multiple logs, including functions for logging SCT statuses and verifying SCTs against known logs.

classes.name: MultiLogCTVerifier::CTLogProvider
classes.description: Provides registration and notification for CT log verifiers.

classes.name: MultiLogCTVerifier
classes.description: Verifies SCTs against multiple known CT logs.

methods.name: LogSCTStatusToUMA
methods.description: Logs SCT verification status to UMA metrics.

methods.name: LogSCTOriginToUMA
methods.description: Logs SCT origin to UMA metrics.

methods.name: AddSCTAndLogStatus
methods.description: Adds an SCT to the list and logs its status.

methods.name: RegisterLogsListCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for log list updates.

methods.name: NotifyCallbacks
methods.description: Notifies registered callbacks with log verifiers.

methods.name: SetLogs
methods.description: Sets the current list of log verifiers.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Main verification function for SCTs in a certificate.

methods.name: VerifySCTs
methods.description: Verifies a list of SCTs from a source against expected entry.

methods.name: VerifySingleSCT
methods.description: Verifies a single SCT against known logs and validity.
